name: snobee searcher
source:
snobee searcher is a game where you, the player, go on a hunt for the elusive cryptid snobee. you are faced with decision after decision, each leading you to one of nine possible endings! 

will you survive?

[From [url=https://zeninix.itch.io/snobee-searcher]Itch.io[/url]]
